description: Undo a recorded batch (drive_cleanup, drive_bulk_trash, drive_trash, drive_bulk_move, drive_move, drive_rename): restores or moves items back, each checked by id; nothing is overwritten, changed items are skipped with a reason. action list (newest 20, no names), plan (default), apply (always asks the user first). Needs the local undo record (PROTON_DRIVE_UNDO=0 turns it off).

id.description: Undo code like K7Q2-M9XD (default: newest batch not yet undone).

name: drive_undo
title: Undo a change
